newsitem.title: USA: Reynolds says to sell aluminum powder, paste plant.
newsitem.headline: Reynolds says to sell aluminum powder, paste plant.

text.p: Reynolds Metals Co said on Wednesday that it had signed a letter of intent to sell its Louisville aluminum powder and paste plant to an affiliate of Eckart Holdings Co Inc.
Reynolds did not disclose the terms of the transaction, but anticipated it would close the deal in the third quarter.
The company also said it expected to offer employment to "a substantial majority" of the 115 people now working at the plant.
Eckart Holdings Co is part of the Eckart group, a privately-held manufacturer and supplier of metallic pigments, pastes, powders and inks.
